reasons: Decision path reads only the observation text: harness.py:55-57 parses cursor (x,y) and Dlvl from obs long_term_context, harness.py:71 parses the rendered `map:` block, harness.py:74-82 parses the language-observation `adjacent` lines, harness.py:167 the message line. No env handle, full_state, oracle field, seed or task id is accessed anywhere in harness.py or tools/*.py.
tools/field.py:267-285 is a BFS over the self-charted terrain (drawn `>` else unvisited frontier) with visit-weighted costs; it plans from what the agent has seen, not from ground truth.
Legal set comes from the system prompt (tools/action_io.py:211-217); no lookup table or per-episode/per-seed hardcoded action sequence.

Model-free steps (harness.py:149-158, 175-183) are honestly marked: model_id='harness', 0 input/output tokens, reasoning = rung name. Trace census: field:descend 1501, reflex:swing 100, reflex:stairs 13, model 679 rows; episode JSONs show input_tokens=0 on fully code-driven episodes (MazeWalk, R3) — cost is not faked, no fabricated llm_calls.
No scorer interaction: act() only returns an action; no writes to summary/result files, no env.step short-circuit, no success flag manipulation.

Behaviour tracks frames (menu ranked by charted field; wins on MazeWalk/R3 via planning, losses on Boxoban/Quest where the field has nothing to offer) — consistent with a legitimate controller, not memorization.
